end.summary:
Discussed earthworms and where they are found in soil.
Pihu identified leaf litter and suggested returning soil animals to their place.
Questions about earthworm feeding and water intake remained unanswered.
Teach-back was not passed; the lesson ended when Pihu said they were tired.
end.parentNote: Asha practised identifying earthworms, mud, leaf litter, and caring for soil animals with Pihu. Pihu connected earthworms with the garden and suggested putting them back, but mixed up what earthworms eat and how they take in water; this was not corrected before stopping. At home, look at a small patch of soil together and name one animal or plant material found there.
